title: `mean` of floats: the sum by the count
description: `mean` is the sum (polars-sum-float, pairwise or Kahan by path) divided by the count.

The mean sums in `f64` whatever the input: `_sum_as_f64` (pairwise, `f32` lanes widened to `f64`) ungrouped, `KahanSum<f64>` per index group in memory. A `Float32` mean is that `f64` quotient rounded to `f32`.

Streaming: `NumMeanReducer` keeps an `f64` sum and a count; a morsel adds its `_sum_as_f64`, a grouped row adds itself (`reduce_one`), and pipelines merge by adding sums and counts. So a grouped mean is Kahan in memory and a plain left-to-right `f64` sum when streaming, as for `sum` (polars-sum-float).
